sanskrit: pratyayārthasya bhāvasya vācyatā pratipāditā / prakṛtyarthavivekārthaṃ vicāraḥ kriyate 'dhunā yā coktā bhāṣyakāreṇa yāgāderabhidheyatā /
english: The fact of the roots yajind the like denoting the sacrifice, &c., that will be put forward by the Bhashya in the Second Adhyāya, is only by way of an explanation of what is duly ascertained in the present Adhikaraṇa. Or, even with regard to the denotations of the rootsyaji, &c., it is only proper that we should consider whether the denotations of these appearing in verbs, consist of the Class or of the Individual. In reality, however, the question that has to be dealt with in the Second Adhyāya is as to whether the transcendental result of the sacrifice proceeds from what is signified by the verbs in the Injunctions, should sacrifice, &c.
